Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Music | National Ghana DJ Clinic 2026 announces power-packed speaker lineup for November 25 Source : Mequry Quaye 2 November 2026 5:22pm Audio By Carbonatix
The 2026 Ghana DJ Clinic is set to take place on Wednesday, November 25, at the British Council in Accra, bringing together some of Ghana's most respected media personalities, technology experts, creative professionals and industry practitioners for a day of learning, networking and professional development.
Organised by Merqury Republic as part of activities leading up to the 2026 Ghana DJ Awards, the clinic is designed to equip DJs, aspiring disc jockeys and music professionals with the knowledge, skills and industry insights needed to build successful and sustainable careers in the evolving entertainment landscape.
Under the overarching theme of the 2026 Ghana DJ Awards, ' All Out ', this year's clinic will focus on critical areas of the modern DJ profession, including personal branding, technology, fashion, financial management and technical performance.
The clinic will feature five distinguished speakers, each bringing unique expertise and practical industry experience to the programme.
Andy Dosty – Beyond the Decks: Building a Powerful DJ Brand That Attracts Fans, Sponsors and Opportunities
Veteran broadcaster and entertainment personality Andy Dosty will explore the importance of building a recognisable and marketable DJ brand. His session will examine how DJs can position themselves professionally, grow their audience, attract sponsorship opportunities and establish stronger relationships within the entertainment industry.
Kwabena Nkrumah – Beyond the Decks: AI, Music Rights and the Digital DJ
Africa's celebrated technology journalist, Kwabena Nkrumah, will take participants into the evolving intersection of technology and DJing. His session will explore artificial intelligence, music rights, copyright considerations and the growing influence of digital innovation on the modern DJ profession.
Calvin Allen Agbenyo – The Power of Fashion in DJ Branding, Image and Stage Presence
Recognising that a DJ's identity extends beyond music, Calvin Allen Agbenyo will examine how fashion, personal image and stage presence contribute to building a distinctive brand. Participants will gain insights into developing a signature look and using visual identity to strengthen their professional appeal.
Rexford Jones Baffoe – Building Wealth, Managing Income and Creating Sustainable Financial Success as a DJ
Financial sustainability remains an important aspect of a successful DJ career. Rexford Jones Baffoe will lead discussions on financial literacy, income management, wealth creation and strategies DJs can adopt to build long-term financial security from their profession.
Victor Apeke – Demonstration of Techniques and Equipment Use
Bringing a practical dimension to the clinic, Victor Apeke will lead a demonstration session focused on DJ techniques and equipment operation. Participants will have the opportunity to gain practical insights into equipment handling, performance techniques and the technical skills required to deliver professional DJ sets.
Beyond the individual sessions, the Ghana DJ Clinic is intended to create an environment where DJs can exchange ideas, learn from experienced professionals, build valuable connections and better understand the business side of their craft.
The programme reflects the growing need for DJs to evolve beyond music selection and performance into well-rounded creative entrepreneurs capable of navigating branding, technology, business, intellectual property and financial management.
The Ghana DJ Clinic also reinforces Merqury Republic's commitment to developing the DJ profession and creating opportunities for knowledge transfer, mentorship and industry advancement.
The clinic forms part of the build-up to the grand finale of the 2026 Ghana DJ Awards, scheduled for December 4, 2026, at the Palms Convention Centre in Accra, where outstanding DJs and industry contributors will be recognised and celebrated.
With an exciting lineup of speakers and practical learning opportunities, the Ghana DJ Clinic 2026 promises to be an important gathering for anyone looking to take their DJ career to the next level.
